The '''First Spear''' was one of the [[Twin Spears]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rekkiad]]. It was where [[Dramath the Second]]'s [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] was located.
